name: Tacos
intro: Sweet potato, poblano, salsa macha, pomegranate. The vegetable taco that doesn't feel like the vegetable option.
season_options: Salted Greek yogurt, instead of crema

variations.ingredients: Sweet potato + poblano + salsa macha + cotija
variations.context: The October taco. Nothing here is optional.
The one to make on a weeknight when nothing is defrosted.
If the fish counter had it. Flour tortillas for this one.

finish: Warm the tortillas over a flame or in a dry pan until they blister in spots, and stack them under a towel. Pomegranate goes on last, so it stays cold against the warm filling.
